summary: Frontend-only verification of the P2 loadReview({preserveLocal:true}) fix in AbcOrderPanel. Executed end-to-end Playwright flow on a submittable draft ABC PO (24a4a8af-a9a1-43f9-bd9a-3296e376535f, MOCK-SHINGLE-ARCH-WW line). (1) Regression: initial panel open populated the delivery editor from server (empty requested_date and appointment type as default). (2) Set requested_date=2026-07-15, appointment_type=Time Range (TR), appointment_from=09:00, appointment_to=12:00, order_comments='TEST_PRESERVE back gate'. Clicked Refresh ABC Pricing (data-testid abc-refresh-pricing). After refresh, ALL five fields remained intact (date/from/to/comments/type). Pricing/review re-fetched (total $1,353.60). (3) Clicked Submit — order confirmed at ABC mock with MOCK-CONF-10006 and 'Requested for 2026-07-15' visible in the ABC Supply Order confirmation dialog, proving the preserved delivery date was carried through submission.
critical_code_review_comments: AbcOrderPanel.jsx line 58: setDelivery((cur) => (opts.preserveLocal && cur ? cur : (data.delivery || {}))) is the correct minimal patch — preserves the entire local delivery object on refresh, seeds from server on initial open (cur is null). Clean.
loadReview is also wired to a useEffect that fires on `open && po && !submitted` (line 63) with no opts — correct initial-load path (preserveLocal falsy).
Only the Refresh button (line 221) passes {preserveLocal:true}; no other call site could accidentally wipe delivery. Contract is tight.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 scenarios: preserve on refresh, initial-load regression, submit-after-refresh regression)

Panel testids stable: abc-refresh-pricing, abc-requested-date, abc-appointment-type (shadcn Select — appointment options: 'No appointment','Anytime','Morning','Afternoon','First Stop','Specific Time','Time Range'), abc-appointment-from, abc-appointment-to, abc-order-comments, abc-review-total, abc-submit-order. After successful submit, the ABC Supply Order confirmation dialog surfaces MOCK-CONF-* and echoes Requested-for date.
rca of the issue: N/A - verification only. Original bug was loadReview() calling setDelivery(data.delivery||{}) unconditionally, so the Refresh ABC Pricing button (which reuses loadReview) wiped local edits. Fix: loadReview(opts={}) now does setDelivery((cur) => (opts.preserveLocal && cur ? cur : (data.delivery||{}))) and only the Refresh button passes preserveLocal:true. Verified end-to-end: local edits survive refresh AND flow through to ABC submission.
